method: Compared every listed stem, four options, key and explanation against opened TDV passages. Source-specific historical reports remain scoped to the named source, not universal or expert-certified facts.

groups.locator: Definition; formation and alternative sixth volumes (96–106); classifications and transmission criticism (108–118); zawaid (125–126)
groups.note: All keyed answers supported. Source distinguishes alternatives; not every report is graded sound. Names cross-checked in linked biographies. The fiqh-arrangement clause in q49-kutub-030 needs a separate Sunan reference.

groups.locator: Shelter, names, direction and changing occupancy (96–100); support/work (101–103); teaching (105–107)
groups.note: Answers and explanations supported. Occupancy figure remains a reported snapshot, not a constant population. The initially named shelter and its later teaching role are distinguished.
